title_zh: 先向同伴练习课堂发言开场

scenario.label_zh: 约定先练习课堂展示的开场
scenario.goal_zh: 说明公开发言顾虑，并同意借助笔记向同伴试讲开场

context_zh: 学生担心课堂展示时忘词，同伴帮助其把第一步缩小到私下试讲。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Elsa
sentences.text: I worry that I will forget everything as soon as I stand up.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Would it help to practise just the first two sentences with me?

sentences.speaker: Elsa
sentences.text: Maybe. Everyone else seems so brave about speaking in front of the class.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: They may be nervous too. You do not have to do the whole talk right now.

sentences.speaker: Elsa
sentences.text: Can I keep my notes in front of me for the first try?

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Of course. I will listen, and then you can tell me which part felt difficult.

sentences.speaker: Elsa
sentences.text: All right. Let us start with the opening before anyone else arrives.
